question: Joe walks east for 60 m from his house. He then takes a left turn and walks for 20 m, turns left and walks for 80 m. He then turns left and walks for 30 m, turns left and walks for 30 m. He takes a final left turn and walks for 10 m and stops. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction he should move in order to reach his house? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Joe walks east for 60 m from his house.

He then takes a left turn and walks for 20 m, turns left and walks for 80 m.

He then turns left and walks for 30 m, turns left and walks for 30 m.

He takes a final left turn and walks for 10 m and stops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98ce391cc224fe586da661ff3982db871487cc688c897325b50435c7ca33315f.png] 

So, He should move **10 m towards the west** in order to reach his house

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
